title: Quentin and the Group Chat
author: J. M. Ishikawa
blurb: Theo Kavanagh, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must save the tradition that made the town before the final audition.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
